findings: No 3.3 or 3.3.1 is printed; the topic is 3.3.2 as printed.
The print's 'all F-P-F angles' for XeF4 is read as F-Xe-F.
The print's 'thank a lone pair' is read as 'than a lone pair'; 'ideal angel' as 'ideal angle'.
The text cites 'Figure 3.11 below' for SnCl2 but no Figure 3.11 is printed; nothing is drawn for it.
The AB2/AB3, AB4 and AB5/AB6 paragraphs are split at each molecule so every figure follows its own sentences, as printed; the old joined VSEPR poster was retired.
